symbolic_statement: For level L>=3 and N=4^L, theta graph has4^(L-3) connected components, each64 sites. Rho sibling edges and pointwise cross coupling also preserve that prefix. Full2N graph has the same number of128-coordinate components.
proof: Every source edge is within a shared great-grandparent (prefix L-3); depth3 edges connect its four16-site groups, and depth2 edges connect distinct4-site groups. Hence each64-site group is connected and no edge leaves it. Diagonal potentials and on-site rho/theta coupling add no cross-prefix edge.
theta_laplacian_zero_space: dimension4^(L-3), because weights are positive and each block is connected
IPR_witness: A unit vector constant on one64-site component has IPR=1/64 and F=N/64. A globally uniform unit vector has F=1. Both are theta Laplacian zero modes; rotations in this degenerate subspace change F. This statement is about H_theta, not an exact eigenvector assertion for coupled H_full.
